items.quote: His last five fights have all ended in the very first round.

items.claim: Uros Medic has questionable durability and has been knocked down or hurt by Gilbert Urbina and Matthew Semelsberger.
items.quote: Gilbert Urbina had knocked him down and had him seriously hurt... Matthew Selesberger hits him, puts him down

items.quote: D-Rod's not really shown all that big of a deficiency in his durability. He can take a shot... D-Rod picks up the pace.

items.claim: Uros Medic was knocked out by Punahele Soriano in 31 seconds.
items.quote: the Puna Hor Soraniano fight... Sorano knocks him out in 31 seconds.
